root_cause_criterion.criterion: After the input-length clamp and before the terminator store, `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()` must ensure `size < sizeof(copy)` so `copy[size] = '\0'` writes inside the fixed 32768-byte `copy` array.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable clamp only reduces `size` when `size > sizeof(copy)`, so the exact-capacity case leaves `size == sizeof(copy)` and the later terminator write uses the first byte past the array. The fixed program clamps to `sizeof(copy) - 1`, so the same sink executes with an in-bounds terminator index.

nodes.state: At `copy[size] = '\0'`, the vulnerable execution reaches the exact boundary case `size == sizeof(copy)`, so the terminating write targets `copy[32768]`, the first byte past the global `copy` buffer.

edges.relation: The post-clamp `size` value flows unchanged from the clamp site to the terminator index used by `copy[size] = '\0'`, so the unchecked equality case at the root is the exact index used at the sink.
